framework_summary: Carpenter Technology's pre-cutoff 10-K (FY2024) contains ZERO named DoD Program Elements, ZERO named Pentagon programs (no F-35, F-22, hypersonic, Skyborg, CCA, B-21, etc.), and ZERO named prime contractor customers. A&D is reported as a single end-use market line ($1,538.8M, 56% of FY2024 sales) without contractor or program disaggregation. Under the J-Book divergence framework, there are NO program-specific claims for pentagon_jbook to falsify — so the framework correctly returns PASS / UNVERIFIABLE rather than firing false-positive RED_FLAGs. This is the expected profile of a Tier-3 commercial-led A&D specialty alloys mill (sells titanium/nickel/cobalt billet & powder to engine OEMs, who in turn sell to primes). The J-Book divergence pattern is structurally inapplicable to this exposure profile.
